import { PENDING_MOVES, REASONS, SEMI_INVULNERABLE_MOVES } from "./doubles-actions";
import { CRASH_MOVES } from "./status-table";
import { DOUBLES_SLOTS, type DoublesSlotId } from "./doubles-types";
import type { PendingAction, World } from "./doubles-world";
import type { HitCheck, TurnKernel, TurnMoveInfo } from "./doubles-turn";
import type { Use } from "./doubles-use";
import type { ChampionsMove } from "./types";

// The hidden state (status2 ADDENDUM2 §3.5, T2M §3.1, C20, C21, C27, C38): Track H's file. Fly, Bounce, Dig, Dive, Phantom
// Force, Shadow Force and Sky Drop out of reach; crash damage. Step 0 moves today's charge-turn guard here verbatim
// (chargeHidden), keeps today's Sky Drop presence guard (skyDrop) and gives a carried hidden release today's reason
// (carriedStart); the other hooks are stubs that change nothing.

/**
 * A semi-invulnerable user (Fly, Dig, Dive, Bounce, Phantom Force, Shadow Force) is not followed past its charge turn
 * while a later living action follows (SPEC §2.2): doubles-turn.ts chargeTurn's guard, moved verbatim.
 */
export function chargeHidden(kernel: TurnKernel, w: World, action: PendingAction, move: ChampionsMove) {
  if (SEMI_INVULNERABLE_MOVES.has(move.id) && kernel.laterAction(w)) kernel.notEstimated(REASONS.semiInvulnerable(kernel.names[action.slot], move.name));
}

/**
 * A carried hidden release (DoublesCarried.charging of Fly, Bounce, Dig, Dive, Phantom Force or Shadow Force: eot.hidden from
 * the turn's start, C38): another Pokémon's move this turn could meet it out of reach. Step 0: today's reason for a hidden
 * Pokémon with a later move (doubles-turn.ts presenceGuards calls it for each slot as the walk starts).
 */
export function carriedStart(kernel: TurnKernel, w: World, slot: DoublesSlotId) {
  const hidden = w.mons[slot]?.eot.hidden;
  if (!hidden) return;
  const others = DOUBLES_SLOTS.some((other) => other !== slot && !!kernel.input.pokemon[other]?.action.moveId);
  if (others) kernel.notEstimated(REASONS.semiInvulnerable(kernel.names[slot], kernel.moveName(hidden)));
}

/** Sky Drop (PENDING_MOVES: it lifts its target): doubles-turn.ts presenceGuards' PENDING_MOVES guard, moved verbatim (C21: H models it in wave 1a). */
export function skyDrop(kernel: TurnKernel, w: World, slot: DoublesSlotId) {
  void w;
  const moveId = kernel.input.pokemon[slot]?.action.moveId;
  if (moveId && PENDING_MOVES.has(moveId)) kernel.notEstimated(REASONS.notIn2v2(kernel.runtime.movesById.get(moveId)!.name));
}

/**
 * The invulnerability step of a damaging move into `slot` (doubles-turn.ts hitChecks, each target first; C27: after
 * presence.invulnerable): a miss as `{ slot, block: { by: "miss", hidden: <the hidden move's name> } }` (blockedHit's fact
 * "{Move} misses {Name} ({Hidden move})."), or null. Step 0: null.
 */
export function misses(kernel: TurnKernel, w: World, action: PendingAction, info: TurnMoveInfo, slot: DoublesSlotId): HitCheck | null {
  void kernel; void w; void action; void info; void slot;
  return null;
}

/** The invulnerability step of a status move into `slot` (doubles-status.ts tryHit, first; after presence.invulnerable): the hidden move's name for the fact "{Move} misses {Name} ({Hidden move}).", or null. Step 0: null. */
export function missesStatus(kernel: TurnKernel, w: World, use: Use, slot: DoublesSlotId): string | null {
  void kernel; void w; void use; void slot;
  return null;
}

/** A field-wide move's reach to `slot` (Perish Song, A3's Teatime): whether the hidden Pokémon is missed. Step 0: false. */
export function missesField(kernel: TurnKernel, w: World, slot: DoublesSlotId, move: ChampionsMove): boolean {
  void kernel; void w; void slot; void move;
  return false;
}

/** A hidden Pokémon lands (Gravity starting, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows): its queued release cancelled. Step 0: nothing. */
export function land(kernel: TurnKernel, w: World, slot: DoublesSlotId) {
  void kernel; void w; void slot;
}

/** Before a move's use (doubles-turn.ts runMove): a carried release leaves its hidden state at its TryMove. Step 0: nothing. */
export function release(kernel: TurnKernel, w: World, action: PendingAction) {
  void kernel; void w; void action;
}

/**
 * Crash damage (status2 Step 1 #10; T2M §3.1.7, C24): High Jump Kick, Jump Kick, Axe Kick and Supercell Slam used as
 * themselves (CRASH_MOVES, generated from the dex's hasCrashDamage; not their Z-Move or Max Move) run MoveFail when every
 * target failed in the hit steps (PS/sim/battle-actions.ts:521-531: a miss, Protect and the shields after their contact
 * effect, Wide Guard, Quick Guard, Mat Block, Telepathy, an absorbing ability, a type or ability immunity: the calculation's
 * no-damage row), and none when it had no target at all (:504-508: damagingMove's no-target branch never reaches here) or met
 * a Substitute or a Disguise (`hit`: a hit reached a target or its Substitute in that world). onMoveFail
 * (PS/data/moves.ts highjumpkick and its kin): `this.damage(source.baseMaxhp / 2, source, source, …)`, truncated, from a
 * non-move effect (Magic Guard stops it; a Berserk lock resets): afterLoss, its Berry at the action's Update; Emergency
 * Exit and Wimp Out read the drop (doubles-turn.ts eventGuards, a damaging action).
 */
export function crash(kernel: TurnKernel, worlds: World[], action: PendingAction, info: TurnMoveInfo, hit: (w: World) => boolean): World[] {
  if (info.transformed || !CRASH_MOVES.has(action.moveId!)) return worlds;
  const user = action.slot;
  const loss = Math.trunc(kernel.hp[user].baseMaxHP / 2);
  return worlds.flatMap((w) => {
    const mon = w.mons[user]!;
    if (!kernel.alive(w, user) || hit(w) || mon.build.abilityId === "magicguard" || loss <= 0) return [w];
    kernel.lossFact(user, `${kernel.names[user]} loses ${loss} HP (${kernel.moveName(action.moveId!)}).`, w.mass);
    return kernel.afterLoss(w, user, loss);
  });
}
